text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: SERVICE=rate-limiter-prod | ALERT=RATE_LIMITER_QUOTA_ANOMALY | severity=critical | count=5020 in 60s
incident-bot: Triggered at 2026-03-14T09:13:09Z
pagerduty: Paging oncall-anna (escalation: oncall -> sre-josh)
pagerduty: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rate-limiter-anomaly
oncall-anna: Acked. I'm on it. heading to terminal.
oncall-anna: brief status? any customer-reported? @customer-success-elaine
customer-success-elaine: Getting multiple CS tickets for 429s, 4 enterprise customers reporting timeouts. Seen beginning ~09:10Z.
sre-josh: jumping in. Looking at limiter metrics - token bucket drop rate spike, quota-mapper returning 0 for many tenant keys.
sre-josh: logs -> paste: {"ts":"2026-03-14T09:10:58Z","svc":"quota-mapper","tenant_id":"tenant_abc","applied_limit":0,"error":"hash-mismatch"}
sre-josh: running: kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=quota-mapper
infra-bot: deployment/quota-mapper-3 restarted 09:12Z via liveness probe
sre-josh: here's a quick query: SELECT mean("errors") FROM "quota_mapper" WHERE time > now() - 5m GROUP BY tenant_id LIMIT 10
sre-josh: hypothesis: a recent rollout introduced a change to the tenant hashing logic -> misapplied quotas
eng-runtime-leah: I pushed a quota-mapper change 09:05Z (PR #5123) that touched tenant hashing fallback. rolling back now.
eng-runtime-leah: kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/quota-mapper
oncall-anna: Rolling back now. Will flip fallback to safe-mode as hotfix: configmap set quota-mapper.fallback=true
oncall-anna: Command:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/quota-mapper QUOTA_MAPPER_FALLBACK=true
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/rate-limiter
```
infra-bot: env updated for deployment/quota-mapper
infra-bot: rollout status deployment/rate-limiter: 3/3 updated
sre-josh: After flip, 429 rate dropped from 18% -> 1.5% in the last 5m. CTRs recovering.
customer-success-elaine: Notifying impacted customers (12 affected tenants total, 4 flagged as high-priority). Sending status update now.
pm-omar: Any degradation to non-generation endpoints? embeddings unaffected?
sre-josh: embeddings traffic unaffected. This is quota enforcement path only.
oncall-anna: PagerDuty: marking incident acknowledged and in mitigation.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by oncall-anna at 09:14Z
sre-josh: Quick safety step: increase rate-limiter circuit threshold to prevent aggressive throttling for 10m:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/params -d '{"service":"rate-limiter","param":"circuit_threshold","value":0.9}'
```
sre-josh: Applied. Monitoring.
oncall-anna: Seeing error budget alerts clear. Will keep under watch 30m.
eng-runtime-leah: I'll follow up with a patch to revert PR #5123 and add a unit test for tenant hashing edgecases.
pm-omar: Assigning postmortem to eng-runtime-leah + sre-josh. Owners will include customer-impact timeline.
customer-success-elaine: Sent customer update: "Investigating quota throttling; mitigation applied, service recovery observed. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA for fix."
oncall-anna: Handoff: I'm on until 09:45Z, then hand to sre-josh for next hour. Leaving notes in the incident channel.
sre-josh: Acknowledge handoff. Will monitor and collect metrics. Will open incident doc.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation cleared. Incident moved to monitoring.
oncall-anna: closing the page for now. :white_check_mark:
sre-josh: Next steps: revert problematic change, add stricter canary, add telemetry for tenant hash mismatches.
eng-runtime-leah: I'll create the revert PR and include rollout gating. ETA 2 hours.
pm-omar: Thanks everyone. Postmortem expected EOD.
